7 studios compete for Carrollton's dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 7 dance and ballroom studios serving the Carrollton market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI. The sites range from 35 to 81. The AI engines name only five of the 7, and all one studios in Flower Mound were never named once. The field averages 46 (F) on AI readiness, 7 of 7 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 6 of 7 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 3 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Carrollton, TX area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 7 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Fred Astaire Dance Studios Carrollton (81) and Dance Amazing (78) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 35. Every one of the top five still carries at least one D or F category.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 46 (F) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 70.
  • 7 of 7 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 6 of 7 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • One of the 7 is a franchise location (one Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #7 is 46 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

2 of 7 studios are never named on any of the 6 checks: Dance Amazing, Calirumba Entertainment. For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. In its two answers, Perplexity cited studios' own websites (fredastaire.com, dancevisiontexas.com). The studios named most are the ones those sources already describe clearly.
  • Being unmistakably “in Carrollton.” Every AI mention went to a studio inside the city. Studios that serve Carrollton from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (7 studios): fredastaire.com/carrollton, danceamazing.com, 2155dance.com, alianzarumbera.square.site, calirumbaentertainment.com, dcdtheacademy.com, dallasweddingdance.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 3 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Carrollton dance searches. Dance Amazing (Flower Mound) came from the same searches run for Lewisville, which this area also covers. Left out: DanceVision's Carrollton and Flower Mound branches (they share one website with DanceVision Plano, which is ranked on the Plano page), Top Hat Dance Centre (website doesn't load), Electric Cowboy (a nightclub), 410 Line Dancers (a line-dance club), kids and recital studios (DCJ Dance, Dance Institute of Dallas and others), and studios in Dallas and Plano, which belong to other Dance Booking Rank areas.

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 3 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Carrollton, TX?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Carrollton, TX?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT and Perplexity logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 3 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons carrollton tx”; “dance lessons carrollton tx”; “salsa lessons carrollton tx”; “wedding dance lessons carrollton tx”; “two step lessons carrollton tx”; “ballroom dance lessons dallas tx”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in carrollton tx” and “ballroom dance studio carrollton”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
